prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Name your new desktop pet and finalize your official adoption registry.", "Pet Name", "Verified Desktop Companion"]
1: ["Calibrate Desktop Workspace", "Verify screen boundaries and position your companion before entering your home desktop.", "Desktop Preview Area", "Test Placement"]
2: ["Meet Your Future Desktop Friend", "See how pets sit on your desktop while you work and play.", "Choose Your Path"]
3: []
4: ["Preparing Desktop Sanctuary", "We will send a notification the moment your companion is ready on your desktop."]
5: ["Welcome Home!", "Your companion is ready on your desktop. Finish setup to claim your Founding Caregiver Badge.", "Founding Caregiver Badge Unlocked"]
6: ["Creating Companion Graphics", "Finalizing pet animations and desktop collision boundary models."]
7: ["In the next step, pick whether to adopt a classic pet or create a custom pet from photos."]
8: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Clear, well-lit photos ensure your custom desktop pet render turns out accurate and detailed."]
9: ["Photo Quality Checklist", "Ensure high render quality by following photo recommendations.", "Single pet visible with clear lighting and neutral background"]

verdicts.problem: Offers a badge or free extra and uses 'Founding' status to create urgency or entice setup completion.
